body:
# Bundl- err, I mean brace yourself! For the Bundles.
Brave bundles as one might even say. But to me they are just casual bundles.

_Or are they...?_ Well, only one way to find out - monitor their moves 24/7 in your main menu.

![Bundles of Bravery Panorama](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e88a69abc1983724320757f5a2bd738b79426e9.webp)

# Features
- Single prerendered panorama of a player using bundles for your main menu

# Not your cup of tea?
Feel free to check out [other panoramas](https://modrinth.com/user/Lumora) that I made for you!
